library.title: Library
library.lede: Everything you’ve made — your notes, your uploads and the work you’ve published.
library.heading: Everything you made
library.unfiled: Not filed in a Space yet

orphan.body: The Lesson this was attached to was removed. Your work is safe, and it keeps its likes — but it has nowhere to open until it is given a new home.

all.title: Nothing here yet
all.body: Anything you write, upload or publish shows up here — gathered from every Space you’re in.

note.title: No notes yet
note.body: Notes are private. Write one while you read and it will be waiting here, next to every other note you’ve made.

material.title: Nothing uploaded yet
material.body: Upload material inside a Space and a Lesson builds itself from it. The file stays yours, and it lists here.

contribution.title: Nothing published yet
contribution.body: Share a summary, a worked example or a set of practice questions with a Space. Whatever you publish lands here, with how it landed.

shelf.title: Library
shelf.lede: What you brought in, what you made of it, and what you shared.
shelf.heading: Your shelf

nothing.query: Nothing on your shelf is called “{{q}}”.
nothing.shared: Nothing shared yet. When a page is ready for others, share it from the page itself.
nothing.reading: Nothing left to read. Everything here is read through.

continue.lead: Pick up where you left off
continue.leadPage: Pick up where you left off · page {{page}} of {{total}}
continue.label: Continue reading {{name}}

bring.label: Bring something in
bring.cellHint: PDF, PPTX or a photo — drop it, or click
bring.emptyHint: PDF, PPTX or a photo. It becomes a page you can read, ask and remember.
bring.cellHintLive: A PDF — drop it, or click
bring.emptyHintLive: A PDF. It becomes a Lesson only you can see — read it, ask it, practise it.

words.title: Your words
words.lede: Every note and every answer you asked for, each one still attached to its page.
words.placeholder: Write it down while it is fresh…
words.empty: Nothing written yet. Notes you write and answers you ask for gather here.
words.unfiled: Not filed in a Space yet
words.orphan: The Lesson this was attached to was removed. Your work is safe, and it keeps its likes — but it has nowhere to open until it is given a new home.

bar.label: Selection
bar.confirmBody: They leave your shelf. You can undo this for a few seconds.
bar.confirmBodyLive_one: Its Lesson goes too, with your progress and practice. Your notes stay. You can undo this for a few seconds — after that it is for good.
bar.confirmBodyLive_other: Their Lessons go too, with your progress and practice. Your notes stay. You can undo this for a few seconds — after that it is for good.

share.title: Share {{name}}
share.intro: Choose a Space. What happens next is written below before you confirm.
share.none: You aren’t in a Space yet. Join or make one, then share from here.

outcome.draft: It becomes a draft Lesson in {{space}}. Only you and editors see it until you publish.
outcome.open: Open Space: it joins the path as a Community Lesson, with your name on it.
outcome.contribution: It arrives as your Contribution, with your name on it. The owner can endorse it into the path.

share.notReady: It can be shared once it’s ready.
share.takeBackBody: It leaves {{space}}. Your page and your words stay.
share.takeBackBodyNoSpace: It leaves its Space. Your page and your words stay.

shelf.ledeLive: What you brought in, and your words from every Lesson.
shelf.wordsEmpty: Notes you write in a Lesson gather here, each one a tap from the page it was written on.

uploads.intro: The original files you uploaded. Deleting one never breaks the Lesson built from it — the Lesson keeps working and says the source was removed.
uploads.published: They are live in their Spaces now.
uploads.deleted: The Lessons built from them keep working.
uploads.emptyBody: Upload material inside a Space and a Lesson builds itself from it.

drafts.intro: Only you can see these. Drafts and Lessons still processing stay private to their author until published — this is the one screen that gathers yours from every Space at once.
drafts.published: They are in their paths now.
drafts.emptyBody: Everything you've started is published. Nothing waiting on you.

impact.intro: Every contribution you’ve published, and what happened to it. Likes are shown per item — they say what people found useful, and never add up to a score.
impact.emptyBody: Share a summary, a worked example or a set of practice questions with a Space, and it will show up here with how it landed.

recall.markIt: {{text}}, revealed — mark whether you knew it

hint.source: Rest on a paragraph to see the source, press S, or ask below · R to recall
hint.noOriginal: Use ← → to move between pages, or ask below · R to recall

blocks.pick: Pick a left and a right side
blocks.begin: Begin with the start set itself.
blocks.pickOne: Pick at least one attribute to start from.
blocks.fired: {{lhs}} is inside the set, so {{fd}} fires and adds {{added}}.
blocks.notKey: Not a key: it never reaches {{rest}}.
blocks.bcnfDone_one: Every relation is in BCNF. {{count}} split, nothing lost: each split keeps the violating FD’s left side in both halves, so the join is lossless.
blocks.bcnfDone_other: Every relation is in BCNF. {{count}} splits, nothing lost: each split keeps the violating FD’s left side in both halves, so the join is lossless.
blocks.bcnfSplit: In {{relation}}, <fd>{{fd}}</fd> has a left side that is not a key. Split it: everything {{lhs}} decides goes to one relation, the rest stays with {{lhs}}.

reading.gone: This one was only on this device, and a reload let it go. Bring it in again from your Library.
